```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
alignment_chr5 <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/chr5_AT5G03415.matrix.txt", header=T) ## do it by gene ! 
# Remove TAIR12
alignment_chr5 <-alignment_chr5[alignment_chr5$V1!="100002",]
ids <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/01_data/full_genomes/full_genomes_frozen_august_2025/Athaliana_assemblies_Paper2_ids.txt", sep="\t")
# Get accessions used in expriment 
sampledata<- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/ddm1_crosses_metadata_2repl_filtered_num_reads_mapping_rate_filtered_outliers_by_pca.txt",header=T, sep=",") %>% dplyr::select(Accession)
sampledata <- unique(sampledata)
```
# Map ids to the data
```{r}
# Replace V1 (Assembly_ID) with Accession_ID
# Replace Assembly_ID with Accession_ID
alignment_chr5$V1 <- ids$Accession_ID[match(alignment_chr5$V1, ids$Assembly_ID)]
# Filter only accessions present in the data
alignment_chr5 <- alignment_chr5[alignment_chr5$V1 %in% sampledata$Accession, ]
```
## Visualize alignment 
```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(msaR)
library(htmlwidgets)
# Extract only nucleotide columns (exclude the ID column, which is column 1)
seqs <- alignment_chr5[, -1, with = FALSE]  # data.table syntax
# Collapse each row into a single string
seq_strings <- apply(seqs, 1, paste, collapse = "")
# Set names as accession IDs from column 1
names(seq_strings) <- alignment_chr5[[1]]  # use [[1]] to safely get first column
# Convert to DNAStringSet

dna_set <- DNAStringSet(seq_strings)
dna_set

msaR(dna_set)  # opens interactive viewer
msa_widget <- msaR(dna_set)
saveWidget(msa_widget, file = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/chr5_AT5G03310.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```

## Make a dendrogram
```{r}
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)  # optional, for nicer trees

seqs_filtered <- seqs # With gaps in 6909

seq_strings <- apply(seqs_filtered, 1, paste, collapse = "")
names(seq_strings) <- alignment_chr5[[1]]
dna_set <- DNAStringSet(seq_strings)

# Convert to DNAbin to ape format
dna_bin <- as.DNAbin(dna_set)
# Compute pairwise distance matrix (p-distance, ignores gaps)
dist_mat <- dist.dna(dna_bin, model = "raw", pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
# Hierarchical clustering
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "complete")  # or "ward.D2", "average"

# Simple dendrogram without gaps
plot(hc, main = "Haplotype Dendrogram - chr5 region",
     xlab = "Accession", sub = "", cex = 0.6)
```
## Visualize with gaps
```{r}
# This at least doesn't delete gap sites, but treats gap vs base as "unknown"

hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "complete")
# Simple base R dendrogram

```

```{r}
library(dendextend)

# Remove 9533
seq_strings_filtered <- seq_strings[names(seq_strings) != "9533"]

dist_mat <- stringDist(DNAStringSet(seq_strings_filtered), method = "hamming")
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "complete")

# Get cluster assignments
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 2)
cat("Cluster 1:\n"); print(names(clusters[clusters == 1]))
cat("Cluster 2:\n"); print(names(clusters[clusters == 2]))

# Plot
dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)
dend <- color_branches(dend, k = 2)
dend <- color_labels(dend, k = 2)

plot(dend,
     main = "Haplotype Dendrogram AT5G03440 (without 9533)",
     xlab = "Accession", sub = "",
     cex = 0.6, ylab = "pairwise Hamming distance")
```

## Color haplotypes based on geography
```{r}
geography <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/metainformtaion_accessions.txt")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
# or use ggmap / leaflet for interactive

# 1. Get haplotype assignments (from your clustering)
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 2)  # adjust k based on dendrogram — looks like 2 main clades
haplotype_table <- data.frame(
  accession_ID = as.integer(names(clusters)),
  Haplotype    = paste0("H", clusters)
)

# 2. Merge with geography
geo_hap <- merge(geography, haplotype_table, by = "accession_ID")

# 3. Clean latitude/longitude (in case they use comma as decimal)
geo_hap$latitude  <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", geo_hap$latitude))
geo_hap$longitude <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", geo_hap$longitude))

# 4. Plot on map
world <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = geo_hap,
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = Haplotype),
             size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-15, 40), ylim = c(30, 70)) +  # zoom to Europe
  scale_color_manual(values = c("H1" = "#E41A1C", "H2" = "#377EB8",
                                "H3" = "#4DAF4A", "H4" = "#984EA3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Haplotype distribution - chr5 AT5G03440 region",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Haplotype")

write.csv2(haplotype_table, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/haplotypes_AT5G03440.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
## Haplotype and expression
```{r}
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 2)  # lades k based on dendrogram — looks like 2 main clades
haplotype_table <- data.frame(
  accession_ID = as.integer(names(clusters)),
  Haplotype    = paste0("H", clusters)
)

pheno <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blup_overall_ddm1_average/rank_transform/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam", header = FALSE) %>% select(V2,V6)
colnames(pheno) <- c("accession_ID", "phenotype")
pheno_with_haplotypes <- inner_join(pheno,haplotype_table, by=c("accession_ID"))


library(ggpubr)

ggplot(pheno_with_haplotypes, aes(x = Haplotype, y = phenotype, fill = Haplotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("H1" = "#E41A1C", "H2" = "#377EB8",
                               "H3" = "#4DAF4A", "H4" = "#984EA3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Phenotype by Haplotype", x = "Haplotype", y = "Phenotype (BLUP)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Correlation with real TPM
```{r}
long_data_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_sene_long_data.csv")
long_data_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_anti_sense_long_data.csv")
# attach strand
long_data_sense$strand <-"+"
long_data_anti_sense$strand <-"-"
# Combine dataframe
long_data_anti_sense2 <- long_data_anti_sense %>%
  mutate(TE = gsub("_AS$", "", TE))

# TEs unique to each direction
sense_only_TEs <- setdiff(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)
anti_only_TEs  <- setdiff(long_data_anti_sense2$TE, long_data_sense$TE)
# Filter and combine
long_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  long_data_sense %>% filter(TE %in% sense_only_TEs),
  long_data_anti_sense2 %>% filter(TE %in% anti_only_TEs)
)
# All TEs, not only unique 
long_data_combined_all <- rbind(long_data_sense,long_data_anti_sense)
```
## Connect TPM values to the genotype 
```{r}
long_data_combined_all <- long_data_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, expression_value, genotype, accession, replicate) %>%
  filter(genotype == "ddm1") %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%                          
  dplyr::summarise(phenotype = mean(log2(expression_value + 1)), .groups = "drop")
```

## Haplotype network
```{r}
library(reshape2)
# Get variable sites only
seq_split <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(seq_strings, ""))
rownames(seq_split) <- names(seq_strings)
# Keep only variable columns
variable_cols <- apply(seq_split, 2, function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1)
seq_variable <- seq_split[, variable_cols]

# Add haplotype info
df_melt <- melt(seq_variable)
colnames(df_melt) <- c("Accession", "Position", "Nucleotide")
df_melt$Haplotype <- haplotype_table$Haplotype[match(df_melt$Accession, haplotype_table$accession_ID)]

# Order by haplotype
df_melt$Accession <- factor(df_melt$Accession, 
                             levels = haplotype_table$accession_ID[order(haplotype_table$Haplotype)])

ggplot(df_melt, aes(x = Position, y = Accession, fill = Nucleotide)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = "#2ecc71", "T" = "#e74c3c",
                               "C" = "#3498db", "G" = "#f39c12", "-" = "grey20")) +
  facet_grid(Haplotype ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)) +
  labs(title = "SNP heatmap by haplotype", x = "Variable sites", y = "Accession")
```
## Put where the SNPs are 
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
library(Gviz)
library(GenomicRanges)

mart <- useMart("plants_mart", 
                dataset = "athaliana_eg_gene",
                host = "https://plants.ensembl.org")

# Step 1: Get transcript/exon structure
exon_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_transcript_id", "external_gene_name",
                 "chromosome_name", "exon_chrom_start", "exon_chrom_end",
                 "rank", "strand", "5_utr_start", "5_utr_end",
                 "3_utr_start", "3_utr_end"),
  filters = c("chromosomal_region"),
  values = list("5:856815:858444"),
  mart = mart
)
```

```{r}
library(Gviz)
library(GenomicRanges)

gene_start <- min(exon_info$exon_chrom_start) - 1000
gene_end   <- max(exon_info$exon_chrom_end) + 1000

# Axis
gtrack <- GenomeAxisTrack()

# Gene structure
gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames   = "5",
  ranges     = IRanges(start = exon_info$exon_chrom_start,
                       end   = exon_info$exon_chrom_end),
  strand     = "+",
  transcript = exon_info$ensembl_transcript_id,
  gene       = exon_info$external_gene_name,
  exon       = paste0("exon", exon_info$rank),
  feature    = "protein_coding"
)

grtrack <- GeneRegionTrack(gr, 
                           name = "AT5G03440",
                           col = "black", fill = "grey80",
                           transcriptAnnotation = "transcript")

# SNPs
snp_track <- AnnotationTrack(
  GRanges("5", IRanges(c(857989,857991,857373,857173,857505,857426,857003,857706,857732,857497,857500,857657,857399,857522,857247,857441,857444,857480), c(857989,857991,857373,857173,857505,857426,857003,857706,857732,857497,857500,857657,857399,857522,857247,857441,857444,857480))),
  name = "SNPs",
  col  = "red", fill = "red",
  fontcolor.feature = "red",
  cex.feature = 0.7
)

# Plot
plotTracks(list(gtrack, grtrack, snp_track),
           chromosome = "5",
           from = gene_start, to = gene_end,
           background.title = "white",
           col.title = "black",
           col.axis = "black")
```

```{r}
# required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)    # for non-overlapping labels

# vector of accessions to highlight (use character or numeric to match your data)
highlight_ids <- c("9511","9537","990","7319")

# prepare data: ensure accession is character if needed
pheno2 <- pheno %>%
  mutate(accession = as.character(V2),
         is_high = if_else(accession %in% highlight_ids, "highlight", "other"))

# plot
ggplot(pheno2, aes(x = V6, y = as.character(V2))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = is_high, size = is_high), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(other = "grey70", highlight = "red")) +
  scale_size_manual(values  = c(other = 1.5,  highlight = 3.5)) +
  # label only the highlighted rows; change label = accession to label = V2 if you want the accession shown
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(pheno2, is_high == "highlight"),
    aes(label = V2),             # or aes(label = accession)
    size = 3.5,
    nudge_y = 0.02 * diff(range(pheno2$V6, na.rm=TRUE)),
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.5
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "", size = "", x = "V2", y = "V6",
       title = "V2 vs V6 — highlighted accessions")
```

## Sort based on the allele
```{r}
library(vcfR)
library(tidyverse)

vcf <- read.vcfR("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/AT5G03415.vcf")

# Extract genotype matrix (0/0, 0/1, 1/0,1/1 → 0, 1,1, 2)
geno <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)

# Convert to dosage (0/0=0, 0/1=1, 1/1=2)
geno_dosage <- apply(geno, 2, function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "0/0" ~ 0,
    x %in% c("0/1", "1/0") ~ 1,
    x == "1/1" ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
})

rownames(geno_dosage) <- paste0(vcf@fix[,"CHROM"], "_", vcf@fix[,"POS"])
geno_dosage <- t(geno_dosage)  
geno_filtered <- geno[rownames(geno) %in% c("Chr5_844294", "Chr5_842795"), ]
geno_filtered <- t(geno_filtered)
geno_filtered <- as.data.frame(geno_filtered)
```

```{r}
# Create a grouping key from the 2 SNPs
geno_filtered$accession <- rownames(geno_filtered)
geno_filtered$group <- paste(geno_filtered$Chr5_842795)

# Order: first by SNP1 (Chr5_842795), then by SNP2 (Chr5_844294)
geno_ordered <- geno_filtered[order(geno_filtered$Chr5_842795), ]
geno_ordered <- geno_ordered[order(geno_ordered$Chr5_842795, decreasing = TRUE), ] %>% na.omit()
accession_order <- geno_ordered$accession
# Get accession order (1/1 first, then 0/0 etc.)
accession_order <- geno_ordered$accession
```



```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# Reorder alignment to match accession_order
alignment_chr5_ordered <- alignment_chr5[match(accession_order, alignment_chr5$V1), ]
# Remove any NAs (accessions in order but not in alignment)
alignment_chr5_ordered <- alignment_chr5_ordered[!is.na(alignment_chr5_ordered$V1), ]

# Extract sequence columns
seqs <- alignment_chr5_ordered[, -1, with = FALSE]

# Remove columns where 6909 has "-"
idx_6909 <- which(alignment_chr5_ordered[[1]] == "6909")
cols_to_keep <- as.logical(unlist(seqs[idx_6909, ] != "-"))
seqs_filtered <- seqs[, which(cols_to_keep), with = FALSE]

# Build sequences
seq_strings <- apply(seqs_filtered, 1, paste, collapse = "")
names(seq_strings) <- alignment_chr5_ordered[[1]]

# Convert to DNAStringSet
dna_set <- DNAStringSet(seq_strings)

# Visualize
msa_widget <- msaR(dna_set)
saveWidget(msa_widget, 
           file = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_847439_plusmin100k/chr5_AT5G03415_snp_ordered_00then11.html", 
           selfcontained = TRUE)

```
